messages:
alex: Heads up — need quick alignment on the 'bid thermostat' for next week's webinar push. Want to avoid weekend overspend but keep search lift. TL;DR: plan = cap bids on low-conv geos, +20% surge on high-intent cohorts, refresh top creatives. Thoughts?

marta: SGTM. Can you share current geo CVR thresholds? I'll map bid adj rules. Also which creatives count as 'top' for this push?

alex: Using GA cohorts 3/4 as high-intent. Geo CVR baseline: US 3.2%, CA 2.1%, EMEA 1.4-2.5. Proposal: thermostat rule = adj = min(1.2, target_cv/baseline_cv) then apply to max CPC; cap overall spend per-campaign 150%. Keeps spikes in check.

jin: I'll handle creative rotation. Current candidates: webinar-teaser-v5, case-study-cta, hands-on-demo, deadline-scarcity. Prefer we A/B teaser + scarcity as primary test.

marta: Plan: create two search ad groups — webinar-high-intent (surge +20%) and webinar-stable (flat). Retargeting: 7d site visitors -> aggressive cap + creative feed 'case-study-cta'. Anyone object to 7d window?

sam (adops-bot): Rule draft pushed to staging:
```json
{"rule_name":"bid_thermostat_v1","match":"geo in [US,CA]","adjust_pct":20,"cap_pct":150,"retarget_window_days":7}
```
Apply ok?

gaurav: Watch attribution lag — last webinar push had a 48-72h conversion tail. Suggest weekend throttle for first 24h post-email send (cap to 80%), then ramp.

marta: @gaurav good call. We'll implement weekend throttle: initial 24h cap 80%, then ramp to target over 48h. Also will exclude low-engagement geos from surge.

alex: Can we set creative swap schedule? Jin, drop teaser day 0-2, case-study day 3-5, scarcity as fallback if CTR drops. Also add pixel exclusion for registrants and recent converters.

jin: Got it. Uploading assets now to our shared bucket -> /ads/2026/webinar/assets. Tagging:
- webinar-teaser-v5_1717804321
- case-study-cta_1717804321
- deadline-scarcity_1717804321
I'll update creative labels in the campaign.

sam (adops-bot): Campaign changes deployed to prod at 1717804800. Monitor burn on dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/marketing/bid-thermostat (live). I'll post alerts if burn > expected by 15%.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll check first-hour burn and ping if we need emergency rollback. Thanks team — will loop back with a quick post-mortem after the first 48h conversion tail.
